definitions.explanation: The ability to grasp the meaning, nature, or significance of something.
A sympathetic awareness of another's situation or feelings.

examples.japanese: {理解|りかい}⟦できますか→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理解|りかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まった→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: My understanding of this problem deepened.

examples.english: It was precisely because he had his family's understanding that he was able to keep pursuing his dream.

notes:
USAGE: {理解|りかい} can refer to intellectual understanding or to sympathetic appreciation of someone's situation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {理解|りかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to understand)
- {理解|りかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧ (to deepen understanding)
- {理解|りかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to gain understanding/approval)
- {理解|りかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (understanding, sympathetic)
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧{理解|りかい}⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please understand - polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ - to understand (casual verb)
- ⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧ - grasp, understanding (formal)
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧ - acceptance, being convinced
